core_obligations: Cover the fibre pointwise using the local structure proposition and note that the fibre of each open piece is an open neighbourhood of the point in the fibre (proof lines 2765-2774).
Choose finitely many points because the fibre is quasi-compact, and one elementary etale neighbourhood dominating all the pointwise neighbourhoods (proof lines 2775-2781).
Take the union of the inverse images of the pointwise opens in the base change, which contains the fibre and on which the pullback is of finite presentation and flat (proof lines 2782-2791).
proof_roadmap: Take the union and read off the two properties (proof lines 2782-2791).
difficulty_reason: The lemma globalises the local structure of a finite type sheaf flat along a fibre: after an elementary etale neighbourhood of the point of the base there is an open subset of the base change containing the fibre on which the pullback is finitely presented and flat (statement lines 2744-2763, tag 05KU). The proof applies the local structure proposition at the points of the quasi-compact fibre, passes to finitely many points, chooses one dominating elementary etale neighbourhood, and takes the union of the base changed opens, where the two properties hold because they hold on each piece. The assembling of the open set is the substance, so the claim is H2.
